What does every term and metric on this report mean?

CoworkBilling.Cowork Total Credits Used.dax:
// Read from the weekly grain so the Cowork/WorkIQ toggle applies - the
// period snapshot on this table sums both services together. TREATAS
// carries whichever people are in scope here across to that grain, so
// grouping by a column of this table still filters correctly.
VAR People = VALUES( 'CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName] )
VAR Wks = [Cowork Period Weeks]
VAR Used =
    CALCULATE(
        SUM( 'CreditsWeekly'[CreditsUsed] ),
        FILTER( ALL( 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] ), 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] < Wks ),
        REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[MetricDate] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Label] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS( 'Date' ),
        TREATAS( People, 'CreditsWeekly'[UserPrincipalName] )
    )
RETURN
    IF( NOT ISEMPTY( People ), ROUND( Used + 0, 0 ) )

CoworkBilling.Chargeback $.dax: [Cowork Total Credits Used] * [Cowork PAYG Rate Value]

CoworkBilling.% of Total Credits.dax: DIVIDE([Cowork Total Credits Used], CALCULATE([Cowork Total Credits Used], REMOVEFILTERS()))

CoworkBilling.Users Over Limit.dax:
VAR T = SUMMARIZE('CoworkBilling', 'CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName], "u", [Cowork Total Credits Used], "l", [Person Allowance])
RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(T, [l] > 0 && [u] > [l])) + 0

CoworkBilling.Users Near Limit.dax:
VAR T = SUMMARIZE('CoworkBilling', 'CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName], "u", [Cowork Total Credits Used], "l", [Person Allowance])
RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(T, [u] >= 0.85 * [l] && [u] <= [l]))

CoworkBilling.Users Within Budget.dax:
VAR T = SUMMARIZE('CoworkBilling', 'CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName], "u", [Cowork Total Credits Used], "l", [Person Allowance])
RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(T, [u] < 0.85 * [l]))

CoworkBilling.Budget Status.dax:
VAR u = [Person Allowance Used %]
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), u > 1, "Over", u >= 0.85, "Near", "Under")

CoworkBilling.Org Avg Credits per User.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Cowork Total Credits Used], REMOVEFILTERS('Org')), CALCULATE([User Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Org')))

CoworkBilling.Dept Avg Credits per User.dax: CALCULATE([Cowork Avg Credits per User], ALLEXCEPT('Org', 'Org'[Department]))

CoworkBilling.Standout Ratio.dax: DIVIDE([Cowork Total Credits Used], [Dept Avg Credits per User])

CoworkBilling.Cowork Top 10% Share.dax:
VAR n     = [User Count]
VAR k     = MAX( 1, ROUND( n * 0.10, 0 ) )
VAR t     = ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName]), "@c", [Cowork Total Credits Used] )
VAR topK  = TOPN( k, t, [@c], DESC )
RETURN DIVIDE( SUMX( topK, [@c] ), [Cowork Total Credits Used] )

CoworkBilling.Top 1% Share.dax:
VAR n     = [User Count]
VAR k     = MAX( 1, ROUND( n * 0.01, 0 ) )
VAR t     = ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName]), "@c", [Cowork Total Credits Used] )
VAR topK  = TOPN( k, t, [@c], DESC )
RETURN DIVIDE( SUMX( topK, [@c] ), [Cowork Total Credits Used] )

CoworkBilling.Consumption Gini.dax:
VAR t =
    FILTER(
        ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('CoworkBilling'[UserPrincipalName]), "@c", [Cowork Total Credits Used] + 0 ),
        [@c] > 0
    )
VAR n   = COUNTROWS(t)
VAR tot = SUMX(t, [@c])
VAR ranked = ADDCOLUMNS( t, "@r", RANKX( t, [@c],, ASC ) )
VAR num = SUMX( ranked, ( 2 * [@r] - n - 1 ) * [@c] )
RETURN IF( n > 1 && tot > 0, DIVIDE( num, n * tot ) )

VAR Limit =
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('SpendingPolicy'[PlanLimit]),
        'SpendingPolicy'[SpendingPolicyId] <> "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

RETURN IF(Limit > 0, Limit)

CoworkBilling.Credits Over Policy Allowa.dax:
SUMX(
    VALUES( 'SpendingPolicy'[SpendingPolicyId] ),
    VAR Lim  = CALCULATE( SUM( 'SpendingPolicy'[PlanLimit] ) )
    VAR Used = CALCULATE( [Cowork Total Credits Used] )
    RETURN IF( Lim > 0, MAX( 0, Used - Lim ), 0 )
)

CoworkBilling.Policies Over Allowance.dax:
COUNTROWS(
    FILTER(
        VALUES( 'SpendingPolicy'[SpendingPolicyId] ),
        VAR Lim  = CALCULATE( SUM( 'SpendingPolicy'[PlanLimit] ) )
        VAR Used = CALCULATE( [Cowork Total Credits Used] )
        RETURN Lim > 0 && Used > Lim
    )
)

CoworkBilling.Blended Rate $.dax: DIVIDE( [Cowork Total Cost], [Cowork Total Credits Used] )

CoworkBilling.Billing Basis.dax:
VAR Bal  = [Cowork Prepaid Balance]
VAR Used = [Cowork Total Credits Used]
RETURN
SWITCH(
TRUE(),
Bal = 0,      "Pay-as-you-go",
Bal >= Used,  "Capacity Packs",
"Capacity Packs, then pay-as-you-go"
)

VAR Wks = [Cowork Period Weeks]
RETURN
CALCULATE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT( 'CreditsWeekly'[UserPrincipalName] ),
    FILTER( ALL( 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] ), 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] < Wks ),
    REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[MetricDate] ),
    REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] ),
    REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Label] ),

CoworkBilling.Action Value /mo.dax:
VAR Rate = [Cowork PAYG Rate Value]
RETURN
SUMX(
    'CoworkBilling',
    VAR Act   = 'CoworkBilling'[Seat Action]
    VAR Limit = 'CoworkBilling'[MonthlyCreditLimit]
    VAR Delta = 'CoworkBilling'[Seat Delta]
    RETURN
        SWITCH(
            LEFT( Act, 1 ),
            "1", Limit * Rate,
            "2", Limit * Rate,
            "3", MAX( 0, Delta ) * Rate,
            "6", -MAX( 0, -Delta ) * Rate,
            0
        )
)

CoworkBilling.Action Meaning.dax:
VAR Act = SELECTEDVALUE( 'CoworkBilling'[Seat Action] )
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        LEFT( Act, 1 ),
        "1", "Release the seat",

VAR SXX = SUMX(T, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] * 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index])

CreditsWeekly.Forecast Accuracy (Backtes.dax:
VAR T =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('CreditsWeekly'[Week Index]), "@y", [Weekly Credits] ),
        ALLSELECTED('CreditsWeekly'[MetricDate]),
        ALLSELECTED('CreditsWeekly'[Week Index]),
        ALLSELECTED('CreditsWeekly'[Week Label]),
        ALLSELECTED('CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago]),
        ALLSELECTED('Date')
    )
VAR MaxIdx = MAXX(T, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index])
VAR Train  = FILTER( T, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] <= MaxIdx - 4 )
VAR Test   = FILTER( T, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] >  MaxIdx - 4 )
VAR N      = COUNTROWS(Train)
VAR SX     = SUMX(Train, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index])
VAR SY     = SUMX(Train, [@y])
VAR SXY    = SUMX(Train, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] * [@y])
VAR SXX    = SUMX(Train, 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] * 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index])
VAR B1     = DIVIDE( N * SXY - SX * SY, N * SXX - SX * SX )
VAR B0     = DIVIDE(SY, N) - B1 * DIVIDE(SX, N)
VAR MAPE   = AVERAGEX( Test, DIVIDE( ABS( [@y] - ( B0 + B1 * 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] ) ), [@y] ) )
RETURN IF( N > 2, 1 - MAPE )

CreditsWeekly.Cowork Weekly Cost.dax:
VAR Wks         = [Cowork Period Weeks]
VAR Bal         = [Cowork Prepaid Balance]
VAR PrepaidRate = [Cowork Prepaid Rate Value]
VAR PaygRate    = [Cowork PAYG Rate Value]
RETURN
SUMX(
    FILTER( VALUES( 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] ), 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] < Wks ),
    VAR ThisAgo  = 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago]
    VAR ThisWeek = CALCULATE( SUM( 'CreditsWeekly'[CreditsUsed] ) )
    // Credits consumed in older weeks inside the period, which have already
    // eaten into the prepaid pack before this week starts.
    //
    // The REMOVEFILTERS matter. On a chart the axis filters Week Label, not
    // Weeks Ago, so clearing Weeks Ago alone left the Week Label filter in
    // place and this returned zero for every week -- the pack then never
    // depleted and every week priced as prepaid.
    VAR PriorUsed =
        CALCULATE(
            SUM( 'CreditsWeekly'[CreditsUsed] ),
            FILTER(
                ALL( 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] ),
                'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] > ThisAgo
                    && 'CreditsWeekly'[Weeks Ago] < Wks
            ),
            REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Label] ),
            REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[Week Index] ),
            REMOVEFILTERS( 'CreditsWeekly'[MetricDate] ),
            REMOVEFILTERS( 'Date' )
        )
    VAR PrepaidLeft = MAX( 0, Bal - PriorUsed )
    VAR PrepaidThis = MIN( ThisWeek, PrepaidLeft )
    VAR PaygThis    = ThisWeek - PrepaidThis
    RETURN PrepaidThis * PrepaidRate + PaygThis * PaygRate
)

Credit Consumption (Tenant).Studio Fitte.dax:
VAR _span = [Studio History Span Days]
            VAR _observed = [Studio Days Observed]
            VAR _fromDate = [Studio Period Start]
            VAR _minDate =
                CALCULATE(
                    MIN( 'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] ),
                    REMOVEFILTERS( 'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] ),
                    'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] >= _fromDate
                )
            VAR _maxDate =
                CALCULATE(
                    MAX( 'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] ),
                    REMOVEFILTERS( 'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] ),
                    'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] >= _fromDate
                )
            RETURN
                IF(
                    _span >= 28
                        && _observed >= 7
                        && NOT ISBLANK( _minDate )
                        && NOT ISBLANK( _maxDate ),
                    VAR _daily =
                        ADDCOLUMNS(
                            CALENDAR( _minDate, _maxDate ),
                            "@x", INT( [Date] - _minDate ),
                            "@credits",
                                VAR _day = [Date]
                                RETURN
                                    COALESCE(
                                        CALCULATE(
                                            [Studio Consumed Credits (Tenant)],
                                            TREATAS( { _day }, 'Credit Consumption (Tenant)'[Usage_Date] )
                                        ),
                                        0
                                    )
                        )
                    VAR _avg7 =
                        FILTER(
                            _daily,
                            [@x] >= 6
                        )
                    VAR _series =
                        ADDCOLUMNS(
                            ADDCOLUMNS(
                                _avg7,
                                "@avg7",
                                    VAR _x = [@x]
                                    RETURN
                                        AVERAGEX(
                                            FILTER( _daily, [@x] >= _x - 6 && [@x] <= _x ),
                                            [@credits]
                                        )
                            ),
                            "@logAvg7", LN( 1 + MAX( 0, [@avg7] ) )
                        )
                    VAR _n = COUNTROWS( _series )
                    VAR _sx = SUMX( _series, [@x] )
                    VAR _sy = SUMX( _series, [@logAvg7] )
                    VAR _sxy = SUMX( _series, [@x] * [@logAvg7] )
                    VAR _sxx = SUMX( _series, [@x] * [@x] )
                    VAR _dailySlope = DIVIDE( _n * _sxy - _sx * _sy, _n * _sxx - _sx * _sx )
                    VAR _boundedSlope = MIN( MAX( 30 * _dailySlope, LN( 0.70 ) ), LN( 1.30 ) )
                    RETURN
                        IF(
                            _n >= 14
                                && COUNTROWS( FILTER( _daily, [@credits] > 0 ) ) >= 7
                                && NOT ISBLANK( _dailySlope ),
                            EXP( _boundedSlope ) - 1
                        )
                )

GitHub Usage.GHCP Observed Growth %.dax:
// VAR names avoid First and Last: both are DAX functions, and a colliding
// VAR name breaks every query on the model rather than just this measure.
VAR FromDate = [GHCP Period Start]
VAR Scoped =
    FILTER( ALL( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ), 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] >= FromDate )
VAR MonthKeys =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Scoped,
        "@ym", YEAR( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ) * 12
                 + MONTH( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] )
    )
VAR FirstMonth = MINX( MonthKeys, [@ym] )
VAR LastMonth  = MAXX( MonthKeys, [@ym] )
VAR Span = LastMonth - FirstMonth
VAR FirstVal =
    CALCULATE(
        SUM( 'GitHub Usage'[Credits] ),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            FILTER(
                ALL( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ),
                YEAR( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ) * 12
                    + MONTH( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ) = FirstMonth
            )
        )
    )
VAR LastVal =
    CALCULATE(
        SUM( 'GitHub Usage'[Credits] ),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            FILTER(
                ALL( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ),
                YEAR( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ) * 12
                    + MONTH( 'GitHub Usage'[Usage_Date] ) = LastMonth
            )
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF( Span > 0 && FirstVal > 0, ( LastVal / FirstVal ) ^ ( 1 / Span ) - 1 )
